**What I did**
- **Fixed a bad channel before the run.** The logbook says the head's seal kit is due, so I checked the head first. Channel 5 (row E) was dispensing about 6.3 µL short at every volume I tested (20, 100 and 180 µL). Per the SOP I set its offset to +6.3 µL. A second check put all 8 channels within ±0.4 µL.

- **This doesn't look like a dispensing problem.** The error is about the same (around 22 %) on both control levels and on every channel. That looks like the controls and the standard disagree on concentration.

If it's the standard or the arm, every sample result is also biased by about 22 %. The cell's tools can't settle this, and the arm isn't covered by `lh verify`.

  station submit                       end the test
